Added the blueprint for the projects UI (`blueprint/projects-ui-2/`, alongside the earlier `blueprint/projects-ui/` plan): the spec for projects and docked tabs, the seven reference screenshots it was drawn against, and a `decisions.md` recording the model as it actually settled after several corrections — projects are views over one machine-wide pool of objects, membership is many-to-many with no owners and no "move", Everything is the unfiltered home, every object has exactly one live page shown in whichever views hold it, and pinning an app to a project is the same fact as its membership rather than a second state layered on top.
